messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "allergy to spironolactone"
set: ["allergy to spironolactone", "spironolactone", "spironolactone treatment", "Spironolactone oral liquid", "allergy to hydrochlorothiazide", "allergy to tamsulosin", "allergy to furosemide", "allergy to losartan", "allergy to Lisinopril", "allergy to metoprolol", "allergy to ondansetron", "allergy to fluticasone", "allergy to Carvedilol", "allergy to buspirone", "allergy to prednisone", "allergy to allopurinol"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
